## About
Mike's Foreign Auto Parts is a used parts yard on Anaheim St in Wilmington. We carry late model auto and truck parts, foreign and domestic, and Jeeps are our specialty.
Customers tell us they come back because we usually have what they need, and because the folks at the counter take the time to check that it's the right part. Shop owners and weekend fixers both rely on us, and we're rated 4.6 from 64 Google reviews.

## Services
- Late model foreign and domestic auto and truck parts: Used parts for imports and domestic makes, for both cars and trucks.
- Specializing in Jeeps: Jeeps are our specialty, so ask us first when you need something for yours.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only carry parts for foreign cars?
A: No. Despite the name, we carry both foreign and domestic auto and truck parts.

Q: Do your parts come with a warranty?
A: Yes. We offer a standard 90 day warranty on all parts except electrical.

Q: Can I check your inventory before I come in?
A: Yes. You can search our inventory on our website, including by image or by searching for several parts at once.
